title: Driver Frontal Deployment Control
description: There is a circuit malfunction in the driver's front airbag deployment control loop.
possibleCauses: Faulty clockspring in the steering wheel
Damaged wiring or poor connections to the airbag
solutions: Inspect and replace the clockspring
Check wiring harness and connectors for damage
Replace the driver airbag module
Diagnose and replace RCM if necessary

title: Passenger Frontal Deployment Control
description: There is a circuit malfunction in the passenger's front airbag deployment control loop.
possibleCauses: Damaged wiring or poor connections to passenger airbag
solutions: Check passenger airbag wiring harness and connectors
Replace the passenger airbag module
Clean corroded connectors
Diagnose and replace RCM if necessary

title: Electronic Control Unit Malfunction
description: An internal malfunction has been detected within one of the vehicle's electronic control modules.
possibleCauses: Water intrusion or damage to the module
Poor ground or power supply to the module
solutions: Check module power and ground circuits
Inspect module for water damage
Attempt to reflash/reprogram the module
Replace the faulty electronic control unit

title: Door Ajar Circuit Fault
description: The body control module is receiving an incorrect signal from a door ajar switch.
possibleCauses: Faulty door ajar switch (often inside the latch)
Broken wire in the door jamb boot
solutions: Test and replace the faulty door latch/switch
Inspect and repair wiring in the door hinge area
Clean electrical connectors
Test BCM inputs

title: Battery Voltage Out of Range
description: A control module has detected that the system battery voltage is either too high or too low.
solutions: Test and charge or replace the battery
Test alternator charging output
Clean and tighten battery terminals
Inspect and clean main ground straps

title: Keyless Entry Transmitter Battery Low
description: The vehicle's receiver has detected a low battery signal from the key fob/remote transmitter.
solutions: Replace the coin battery in the key fob
Clean key fob internal contacts
Reprogram or replace the key fob if issues persist
